headerDisplay: Control a Nimbio cellular gate from Apple HomeKit. Paste a live API key from the Nimbio portal — Homebridge stores it in the local config.
footerDisplay: After saving, restart Homebridge. Discovered gates appear in the Apple Home app. Advanced options are optional.

name.title: Name
name.description: Label for this plugin in Homebridge logs.

apiKey.title: Nimbio API Key
apiKey.description: Live API key from the Nimbio portal (starts with nimbio_live_). Required; treat it like a physical remote.

autoCloseSeconds.title: Seconds until HomeKit shows Closed
autoCloseSeconds.description: Most Nimbio homeowner setups cannot report when the gate physically closes. Set this to match your opener’s hardware auto-close (often about 15 seconds) so the Home app returns to Closed on its own.

pulseOnClose.title: Also pulse when closing
pulseOnClose.description: Turn this on if your gate needs a second remote press to close. Most users can leave this off.

accessoryType.title: HomeKit accessory type
accessoryType.description: Garage Door Opener is the usual control. Switch fires open when turned On, then returns to Off.

latchIds.title: Latch IDs to expose
latchIds.description: Optional. Leave empty to expose every latch available to the API key. Otherwise only the listed latch IDs appear in Home.

namePrefix.title: Name prefix
namePrefix.description: Optional prefix prepended to discovered latch names.

latchNames.title: Latch display names
latchNames.description: Optional map of latch ID to HomeKit display name. Usually easier to rename in the Home app.

openNote.title: Open note
openNote.description: Note stored with each Nimbio open request.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Status poll interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: Community keys with a sense line only. How often to poll gate-status. Set to 0 to disable polling.

timeoutSeconds.title: API timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for Nimbio open confirmation (cellular opens often take 15–20 seconds).

baseUrl.title: API base URL
baseUrl.description: Optional override. Leave blank to use the production Nimbio API.
